title: cargo audit 4 CVE + 2 warnings — RUSTSEC-2025-0134 anyhow unsound + RUSTSEC-2026-0190
description:
PR #148 canary (EPIC-136-C 装上第一天) 抓到 rust/Cargo.lock 中 4 vulnerabilities + 2 denied warnings. `cargo audit --deny warnings` 阻塞 CI.

**已确认 finding (raw output from PR #148 run 30199368393)**:
- RUSTSEC-2025-0134: `anyhow@1.0.102` — Unsoundness in `Error::downcast_mut()` (2025-11-28)
- RUSTSEC-2026-0190: (待读完整 log 补, 2026-06-25 date)
- 4 vulnerabilities total + 2 denied warnings

**修复策略** (跟 docs/reference/supply-chain-cargo.md 联合):
1. 优先 `cargo update -p <crate>` 升到修好版本
2. 若 upstream 未 release, 用 `[patch.crates-io]` 临时 patch
3. 若 anyhow 上游还没修, 评估切 `thiserror` (KALLAX 大部分错误已经用 thiserror)

**追责链**: 本 ticket 是 EPIC-136-C canary 发现的技术债, 不是新 bug — 是历史包袱 (从 v3.28.0 前就存在, 只是没 CI 检测).

**验收**: CI cargo-audit workflow 全绿 (exit 0), `cd rust && cargo audit --deny warnings` 本地 PASS.
acceptance: cargo audit --deny warnings 本地 PASS (0 CVE, 0 warnings)
如果用 [patch.crates-io], 附上游 issue/PR 链接
更新 docs/reference/supply-chain-cargo.md CVE 响应记录段 (real-world case)
